scheme_name: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification
description:
The Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification scheme was launched by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in India in 2015. 

This scheme aims to enhance the skills of service providers across various sectors. 

The initiative is part of the larger Skill India Mission which was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 15, 2015. 

The objective of this scheme is to ensure that service providers are adequately trained and certified to meet industry standards. 

The scheme specifically targets the unorganized sector which employs a significant portion of the Indian workforce. 

According to the 2019 Periodic Labour Force Survey, around 94% of India’s workforce is employed in the unorganized sector. 

This scheme aims to provide skill testing and certification to these workers to improve their employability. 

The measurable target of the scheme is to train and certify approximately 10 million service providers by 2025. 

The scheme also aims to bridge the skill gap in various sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, and construction. 

The benefits of the scheme include skill testing and certification for service providers. 

Successful candidates receive a certificate that is recognized by the government and industry. 

This certification enhances the employability of the workers and increases their earning potential. 

The scheme also aims to improve the quality of services provided by these workers. 

For example, a certified service provider in the hospitality sector can earn between INR 15,000 to INR 25,000 per month. 

In the healthcare sector, certified workers can earn between INR 10,000 to INR 20,000 per month. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme include individuals aged between 18 to 45 years. 

Candidates must have a minimum educational qualification of Class 8. 

There are no specific income criteria for applicants. 

However, preference is given to individuals from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the scheme involves several steps. 

First, interested candidates must visit the official website of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

They need to fill out an online application form with personal details. 

Required documents include a government-issued ID proof and educational certificates. 

Once the application is submitted, candidates will receive a confirmation message. 

The next step involves attending an orientation session conducted by the implementing agency. 

Candidates will then undergo skill training sessions which vary in duration based on the sector. 

After completing the training, candidates will be assessed through a skill testing process. 

This assessment is conducted by certified assessors from recognized agencies. 

Candidates who pass the assessment will receive their certification within 30 days. 

The scheme also includes a provision for re-assessment for candidates who do not pass the first time. 

The frequency of skill testing and certification is ongoing. 

There are no specific deadlines for application as the scheme is designed to operate continuously. 

The implementing authorities for this scheme include the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

State Skill Development Missions also play a crucial role in the implementation at the state level. 

Contact details for the Ministry can be found on their official website. 

The scheme has seen participation from various stakeholders including industry partners and training providers. 

According to reports, over 1 million service providers have been trained and certified under this scheme as of 2023. 

The scheme has contributed significantly to improving the skill levels of workers in the unorganized sector. 

It has also facilitated better job opportunities and higher wages for certified individuals. 

In addition to individual benefits, the scheme aims to enhance the overall quality of services in the economy. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 500 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This funding is aimed at expanding the reach of the program to more regions across the country. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of digital literacy among service providers. 

Training modules include components on using technology in service delivery. 

The scheme is aligned with the National Policy for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship 2015. 

This policy aims to create a skilled workforce that meets the demands of the economy. 

The Capacity Building For Service Providers scheme is a vital part of this larger framework. 

It addresses the urgent need for skill development in a rapidly changing job market. 

The government regularly reviews the progress of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback from participants is collected to improve training modules and assessment processes. 

The scheme is also supported by various non-governmental organizations and private sector partners. 

These partnerships help in reaching a wider audience and providing quality training. 

The success of the scheme is measured through various metrics including employment rates and income levels of certified individuals. 

The government aims to continuously improve the scheme based on these metrics. 

Overall, the Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification scheme is a comprehensive initiative. 

It is designed to empower service providers through skill development and certification. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in enhancing the employability and earning potential of workers in the unorganized sector. 

By focusing on skill testing and certification, the government aims to uplift millions of individuals across the country. 

This initiative is a significant step towards achieving the broader goals of the Skill India Mission. 

It reflects the government's commitment to fostering a skilled workforce that can contribute to the nation's economic growth. 

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of the labor market. 

In conclusion, the Capacity Building For Service Providers - Skill Testing & Certification scheme is an essential welfare initiative. 

It provides concrete benefits and opportunities for service providers in India. 

The ongoing support and funding from the government ensure its sustainability and effectiveness.
